title:
`ALTER TABLE users`
locked the production database
for 47 minutes.
subtitle: Adding a nullable `is_cool` boolean column seemed harmless. In reality, Postgres acquired an exclusive table lock on 90 million rows during peak Black Friday checkout traffic.
logs: > executing SQL: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN is_cool BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;`
> acquiring ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on 'users' table...
> lock acquired. 4,200 incoming checkout queries queued.
> backend services dropping connections across 8 microservices.
> DBA frantically trying to type `SELECT pg_cancel_backend(...)`...
> CEO joins incident Slack channel: 'Why is revenue $0 this hour?'
footnote: Error code: `EXCLUSIVE-LOCK-404` · Rows locked: 90,000,000 · DBA blood pressure: 220/140
pathTemplate: Access to `{path}` was blocked while the database spent 45 minutes locking 90M rows for a boolean flag.
